verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a hardware passkey authenticator, but the pack never documents listing or deleting resident FIDO2 credentials, or reporting remaining credential capacity. The ykman CLI evidence covers applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots and device info only. python-fido2 and the SDKs are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can list and delete the passkeys stored on my key and know its credential capacity before it fills up
